stages.description: ABB 的 YuMi 案例以雙臂小件裝配為背景，適合分析交接與同步。；在時間線標左臂備料、右臂備料、雙臂交接及裝配資源鎖。
stages.descriptionEn: ABB presents YuMi in small-part assembly, providing a case for handover and synchronization.; Mark left preparation, right preparation, shared handover and the assembly resource lock on a timeline.
